notes: LAUNCH-CRITICAL CHECK CONFIRMED (Scenario 9, HG3 hard gate, part 3 of 5): a company with excellent AI maturity signals (93% readiness, Architect archetype, real measurable results, dedicated AI owner) and a workflow reported as running smoothly with zero symptoms (Q11a='running smoothly', Q11b='None of these') is correctly rejected — no CTA. This is the textbook HG3 case: high organizational readiness cannot compensate for a workflow that isn't actually a problem. Notably the Layer B 'Where this leaves you' positioning copy again reads favorably ('You're positioned to move on this now... rarer than it sounds') despite the REJECT outcome — reconfirming for the third time in this run that Layer B commentary is decoupled from the Layer C accept/reject decision and CTA gating.
